additional_info.body:
Dear PIng,
Thank you for reaching out.
Following your request and our review, we have identified that the issue is related to the LEM DC Meter
"logbookIntegrityIsFailed"
. To resolve it, we need to remove the LEM address and require your confirmation before proceeding.
Please note that if the issue persists, we will take the necessary steps to resolve it.
Should you require any additional information or assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind regards,
Anass Mezzaoui
eMobility Technical Support Team
